name: Wave pipeline
description: Builds one ticket: the Builder writes the failing test first, then the code; the Code Reviewer sends it back until it is approved (bounded); the Integrator opens a draft merge request; the operator pulls the branch and runs the CI tasks locally (bugs go back to the Builder); the Doc Auditor updates the plan documents and traces the requirements, escalating a PRD gap or a wrong design instead of finishing; the Integrator then marks the merge request ready with code and documents.

task.description: The ticket: title, slice, files and acceptance tests. It must name its feature on a line "Feature: <slug>" (the plan is in docs/plans/<slug>/) until issues carry it

nodes.message:
Pull branch {{.state.integrator_draft.branch}} and run the CI tasks locally (the project's build, lint and test commands), then try the change by hand. Draft merge request: {{.state.integrator_draft.merge_request_url}}
Approve when it works. Reject with the bugs you found: they go back to the Builder.
